data.name: University of Texas at Austin Dataverse Collection
data.affiliation: The University of Texas at Austin
data.description:
The University of Texas at Austin Dataverse Collection serves as a platform for publishing and archiving the University's research data. It was established to help UT Austin's research community meet the data sharing requirements of funders and publishers, to facilitate data citation, to promote collaboration, to enable reproducibility, and to encourage data reuse.

For general helpdesk support, please email support@tdl.org. Anyone experiencing accessibility issues with material in the UT Austin dataverse collection in the Texas Data Repository can contact UT Library staff at utl-orc@austin.utexas.edu.
